title: Technical Content Writer- Technical Support
description:
**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

The Technical Content Writer – Electrical is responsible for developing, maintaining, and continuously improving high-quality technical documentation for electrical products, systems, and processes. This role translates complex electrical engineering concepts into clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation for internal and external stakeholders. The position collaborates closely with engineers, product specialists, and business partners, while leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, consistency, and quality of technical content.

A. Documentation Development  
Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation in alignment with organizational standards and guidelines.  
Write, edit, and update process manuals, user manuals, training materials, white papers, technical reports, and other supporting documentation.  
B. Content Creation and Translation  
Translate complex electrical engineering concepts, product features, and system behavior into clear, accurate, and user-friendly content.  
Ensure documentation supports both technical and non-technical audiences.  
C. Collaboration and Information Validation  
Collaborate closely with Product Specialists, engineers, and business partners to gather accurate and detailed technical information related to electrical products and systems.  
Validate all technical content through reviews with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).  
D. AI-Assisted Content Development  
Utilize AI tools to generate initial drafts, outlines, or content suggestions.  
Review, refine, and enhance AI-generated content to ensure accuracy, clarity, consistency, and compliance with organizational standards.  
E. Database and Knowledge Management  
Develop and maintain structured databases of reference materials, including research data, usability studies, design specifications, and technical references.  
Ensure documentation is version-controlled, traceable, and easily retrievable.  
F. Quality Assurance and Compliance  
Review and proofread documentation to ensure grammatical accuracy, technical correctness, consistency, and adherence to style and branding guidelines.  
Ensure all documentation complies with organizational, legal, and quality standards.  
G. Process Documentation and Improvement  
Document current and future process states using Value Stream Mapping to support process understanding and improvement.  
Apply standard work, error proofing, and application knowledge to drive continuous improvement in documentation processes.  
H. Information Architecture  
Research, create, and maintain information architecture templates that support scalability, reuse, and easy data migration.  
Ensure alignment with organizational and legal requirements.  
I. User Feedback and Content Evaluation  
Analyze user feedback and AI-generated insights to understand user interactions with documentation.  
Identify gaps and opportunities for improvement and implement innovative approaches to enhance content effectiveness.  
J. Continuous Improvement and Best Practices  
Evaluate existing documentation and implement best practices to improve quality, usability, and efficiency.  
Contribute to the development and adherence of Quality Control processes for all documentation releases.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

Graduate in Engineering (Electrical / Electronics) or Graduate with relevant technical documentation experience in the electrical domain.  
Minimum 2–6 years of experience in technical documentation, technical writing, or content development for electrical products, systems, or engineering-driven environments.

**Skills:**
-----------

1. Strong understanding of electrical products, systems, and engineering documentation.  
2. Ability to read, interpret, and document technical drawings, specifications, and engineering data.  
3. Experience developing user manuals, process documentation, training materials, and technical reports.  
4. Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and documentation platforms such as SharePoint.  
6. Experience using documentation tools and content management systems.  
7. Working knowledge of AI-assisted content creation tools and best practices for responsible use.  
8. Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.  
9. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.  
10. Experience working with technical authoring and documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, Adobe FrameMaker, Adobe RoboHelp, DITA XML, or other similar structured

title: Solution Engineer Senior
description:
**Job Summary:**

Responsible for analyzing and gathering business and technical requirements to design and document fit-for-purpose solutions. Contributes to solution development, design, integration and testing, and configuration of technology solutions ensuring that delivered solutions adhere to defined architecture and security standards. Works closely with with cross-functional teams, vendors, and business partners to ensure smooth execution and continuous improvement in solution performance and quality. Ensure seamless solution implementation and effective issue resolution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Supports the design of fit-for-purpose solutions by collaborating with stakeholders to identify integration points and ensure alignment with business processes and goals. Supports technical analysis, design and customization of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial-off-the-shelf products versus custom built solution. Develops and maintains technical design documents, workflows, and architecture diagrams. Assists in defining and executing the test strategy and validating solutions against business objectives. Ensures smooth interoperability by validating integrations and documenting configuration steps. Identifies and communicates potential technical dependencies and risks. Works with vendors and IT service providers to address technical issues, evaluate and improve product functionality and ensure proper configuration according to design specifications. Designs and implements data migration solutions to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Develops, designs, tests, maintains and configures solutions and systems as needed. Serves as subject matter expert and point of contact on content, processes, procedures and functionality associated with assigned applications for projects and application support (as needed). Documents recommendations to enhance business process efficiency and increase adoption of standard application features and capabilities, aligning solutions with enterprise standards. Supports continuous improvement initiatives by following established design standards and learning to identify potential enhancements in solution design or workflow efficiency. Assists technical and infrastructure groups in understanding the solution design and specifications. Works closely with IT technical service providers to ensure outsourced work packages are delivered to specifications, meeting key parameters of quality, schedule, cost, data privacy, security, performance, and scalability. Participates in formal design reviews, cybersecurity reviews and code reviews (where applicable) to ensure the detailed design specifications have been understood and coding standards and cybersecurity regulations have been adhered to by the development team(s). Competencies: Security & Compliance Principles - Applies standards, tools, and best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems, software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost. Programming Principles - Applies programming languages, frameworks, and patterns to design, write, configure, test, and maintain software/solutions/systems that are efficient, secure, scalable, and reliable. Data Principles - Governs, models, secures, implements, and observes data flows to ensure integrity, quality, and compliance—enabling trusted, scalable, cost-conscious data use. Modern Development Practices - Applies modern engineering practices and tools—such as Agile/DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure as code—to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and reduce risk across the SDLC. Solution Design - Translate business requirements into integrated designs, architectures, patterns, and system interactions that deliver customer value and align with enterprise standards and subject-matter platforms. Demonstrating Mastery - Maintains essential knowledge and proficiency in relevant domains, tools, technologies, methodologies, or frameworks through targeted credentials and rigorous proficiency, future-proofing organizational skills against strategic needs. Strategic and Innovative Thinking - Evaluates business and technology trends, anticipates future needs, develops creative approaches, and frames innovations to shape strategy and create durable value with cost-aware innovation. Technical Passion & Drive - Models curiosity and excitement for technology by self-initiating continuous development, experimenting with emerging technologies, and identifying insertion opportunities that accelerate business performance. Driving Effective Outcomes - Takes ownership, acts with urgency, and initiates action to turn goals into clear plans, decisions, guardrails, and cadences while navigating ambiguity and change to drive momentum and deliver consistent results. Engaging with Impact - Communicates with clarity and purpose to align stakeholders, foster collaboration, build trust, and influence coordinated action across teams and functions to accelerate outcomes. Values Differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization. Ensuring Customer Success - Embraces a customer-first mindset to deliver outcomes by linking customer needs and business priorities to aligned solutions, delivery, adoption, satisfaction, and realized value through sustained engagement that builds partnership and trust. Education, Licenses, Certifications: College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations. Experience: Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 3-5 years of experience.

title: Export Documentation Executive
description:
Job Title: Export Documentation Executive

Job Summary: Responsible for preparing, verifying, and managing export documents to ensure timely and compliant international shipments in accordance with customs regulations and company procedures.

Key Responsibilities

* Prepare export documents, including commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, and bills of lading.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines, and transporters.
* Prepare and verify certificates of origin and other applicable export certificates.
* Coordinate with banks for Letter of Credit (LC) documentation and export payment documents.
* Ensure compliance with DGFT, customs, and other applicable export regulations.
* Track export shipments and maintain records of dispatches and documentation.
* Coordinate with production, sales, logistics, and warehouse teams.
* Handle post-shipment documentation and resolve documentation discrepancies.

Required Skills

* Knowledge of export-import (EXIM) procedures and documentation.
* Understanding of Incoterms, shipping terms, and customs clearance.
* Good communication, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and documentation systems.
* Attention to detail and ability to meet shipment deadlines.

Qualifications and Experience

* Education: Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience: 1–3 years in export documentation preferred.
